title.en: Consolidate course pricing into nine products
title.zh: 课程价格统一为九个产品

purpose.en: Remove language-expanded price rows from the administrator and SmartPay3 flows so SmartLingo has exactly nine course-price products while students still choose the language they want to learn.
purpose.zh: 从管理员与 SmartPay3 流程中移除按语言重复展开的价格行，让 SmartLingo 只保留九个课程价格产品，同时仍由学生选择要学习的语言。

en: Show exactly nine price products: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced for 3, 6, or 12 months.
Keep card checkout on all nine products and Polygon USDT/GLC checkout only on the three three-month products.
Carry the selected learning language into SmartPay3 as the payment secondId without duplicating the on-chain price rule.
zh: 仅显示九个价格产品：初期、中级、高级课程各提供 3、6、12 个月。
九个产品全部支持银行卡付款，Polygon USDT/GLC 仅用于三个 3 个月产品。
将学生选择的学习语言作为付款 secondId 写入 SmartPay3，同时不再重复创建链上价格规则。

en: Administrator course-price page and dashboard, public course package pages, SmartPay3 rule administration, crypto checkout options, payment reconciliation, contract ABI, and integration documentation.
zh: 管理员课程价格页与仪表板、公开课程套餐页、SmartPay3 规则管理、加密付款选项、付款对账、合约 ABI 及集成文档。

en: Replace the raw language-class table on the price administration route with three level cards containing the canonical nine products and prices.
Store three shared three-month SmartPay3 price rules and validate the twelve supported language codes only when a student pays.
Require a supported language on the crypto-options API and generate checkout choices only for that selected language.
Keep the shared empty SmartPay3 rule secondId as a TypeScript literal so CI and runtime use the same product-rule contract.
Preserve all operational language courses, course content, user access records, and existing site-specific service boundaries.
zh: 将价格管理路由上的原始语言课程表替换为三个等级卡片，列出权威九个产品与价格。
SmartPay3 只保存三个共享的 3 个月价格规则，并仅在学生付款时验证十二种受支持语言。
加密付款选项 API 必须收到受支持语言，并且只为该语言生成结账选项。
将共享 SmartPay3 价格规则的空 secondId 固定为 TypeScript 字面量，让 CI 与运行时采用同一产品规则契约。
保留全部实际语言课程、课程内容、用户权限记录及现有站点专属服务边界。

en: Passed the production build, zero-warning lint, 409 site tests, 68-migration replay and idempotency checks, sensitive-data scan, shared architecture contracts, and 270/270 WebKit responsive-layout checks.
Verified Chinese-learning-Japanese and English-learning-Italian package flows in a real browser, including prices, language-scoped links, and the three crypto-enabled products.
zh: 通过生产构建、零警告 lint、409 项站点测试、68 个迁移重放与幂等检查、敏感数据扫描、共享架构契约及 270/270 WebKit 响应式版面检查。
使用真实浏览器验证中文学日语与英文学意大利语套餐流程，包括价格、按语言限定的链接及三个可用加密付款产品。

en: Automated validation does not submit a real card or token payment. An authorized wallet owner must deploy the updated SmartPay3 contract and publish its three product rules before Polygon checkout can be enabled.
zh: 自动验证不会提交真实银行卡或代币付款；Polygon 结账启用前，必须由授权钱包所有者部署更新后的 SmartPay3 合约并发布三个产品规则。

en: Keep SmartLingo's twelve learning languages, Clerk identity, D1 data, Stripe, SmartPay3, wallets, college revenue sharing, and GitHub Actions to Cloudflare deployment isolated from every other site.
zh: 继续保持 SmartLingo 的十二种学习语言、Clerk 身份、D1 数据、Stripe、SmartPay3、钱包、学院分成及 GitHub Actions 到 Cloudflare 发布流程与其他站点完全隔离。
